property_summary: For all callers, onlyAdmin enforces that setOwner returns true only when called by the admin; the mutant that removes the require lets non-admin callers successfully call setOwner and still return true, violating that admin-restriction observable via the return/behavior for some callers.
change_summary: Modify onlyAdmin to always allow calls (no revert) by removing the require and leaving a no-op; this changes whether setOwner can be called by non-admins, altering observable return behavior for some callers.
